message.content: {"note_claim": "The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 died in the crashes.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Al-Qaeda suicide operatives hijacked and crashed United Airlines Flight 175 and American Airlines Flight 11 into the twin towers of the World Trade Center and crashed American Airlines Flight 77 into the Pentagon.", "reason": "The page is on the same topic of 9/11 conspiracy theories and is consistent with the note by describing the hijackers as 'suicide operatives,' but it does not directly address the specific claims about hijackers surviving, identity theft, or the FBI confirming all 19 died."}

parsed.note_claim: The video's narration falsely claims some 9/11 hijackers survived and were victims of identity theft; the FBI confirmed all 19 died in the crashes.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Al-Qaeda suicide operatives hijacked and crashed United Airlines Flight 175 and American Airlines Flight 11 into the twin towers of the World Trade Center and crashed American Airlines Flight 77 into the Pentagon.
parsed.reason: The page is on the same topic of 9/11 conspiracy theories and is consistent with the note by describing the hijackers as 'suicide operatives,' but it does not directly address the specific claims about hijackers surviving, identity theft, or the FBI confirming all 19 died.
